'''Tyger Burning Bright''' was a club that was located in the city of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Description and features==
The club was located near the center of Bayonard and was much more respectable than the nearby [[Space Monkey Café]]. It was only open during the hours of darkness. It had a regular program of stage performances that were interspersed with dancing. Snacks and drinks could also be purchased there.

==History==
The club was run by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Tyger]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Selima DeWitt]], a friend of Tyger, went missing. The [[heroes of Cularin]], who had been hired to find her, traveled to the club, to speak to Tyger about her.
